La cession de propriété intellectuelle :: IP assignment: everything created for the company (code, brand, patents, designs) belongs to the company, not to the founders personally. Without it, the main asset could slip out of the company's hands.
La clause de « changement défavorable si: The material adverse change (MAC) clause: if a serious event badly damages the company before signing, the investor can walk away. It is a safety net against a major last-minute surprise.
La clause de la « nation la plus favoris: The most-favoured nation (MFN) clause: if a future investor gets better terms, the current investor can claim the same. It guarantees they are never treated worse than those who come later.
La clause de liquidité : si aucune sorti: The liquidity clause: if no exit (sale, IPO) happens within a set period, the investor can trigger a mechanism to get their money back. It is their way out if the venture drags on.
La clause de rachat (« redemption ») : d: The redemption clause: in specific cases and after several years, the investor can ask the company to buy back their shares. It is a last-resort exit if no sale happens.
La durée de validité du document : une d: The document's period of validity: a deadline by which the deal must be signed. After that, the letter of intent lapses and you have to renegotiate.
La lettre d'intention expire si non sign: The letter of intent expires if not signed within 30 days
La médiation préalable : en cas de litig: Mandatory mediation first: in a dispute, the parties undertake to try to reach agreement with a neutral mediator before going to court. It is generally faster, cheaper and less adversarial than litigation.
La non-concurrence : pendant une durée d: The non-compete: for a defined period after they leave, the founders cannot launch or join a competitor, or poach the team. It protects the company against a departure that would directly harm it.
La non-sollicitation : après son départ,: Non-solicitation: after leaving, a founder undertakes not to approach the company's customers or employees to draw them elsewhere. Narrower than the non-compete, which bars any competing activity.
La préemption ne joue pas pour les trans: Pre-emption does not apply to transfers to close family
La sanction ne joue pas pour les petites: The penalty does not apply to small technical issues of shares
La société assure les fondateurs : en ca: The company insures the founders: on death or incapacity, it receives a payout to absorb the shock.
La Société détient ses actifs clés, libr: The Company owns its key assets, free of any charge
La Société garantit la propriété et l'ab: The Company warrants ownership and non-infringement
La Société peut lever la non-concurrence: The Company can waive the non-compete and stop paying the compensation
La Société rembourse les frais si elle r: The Company reimburses the costs if it breaks off in breach
La société s'engage à transmettre chaque: The company undertakes to send investors detailed reporting every quarter (accounts, cash, KPIs).
La structure et la numérotation du docum: The structure and numbering of the original document are preserved.
La version proportionnelle du tag-along: The proportional version of the tag-along: if the investor sells only part of their shares, the founders can sell the same proportion of theirs, on the same terms.
Laisse aux parties la liberté de renonce: Leaves the parties free to walk away if due diligence reveals a major problem.
Le « censeur » : l'investisseur peut env: The observer: the investor can send a representative to attend strategic committee meetings. They listen and give their view, but do not vote. It is an observing presence, with no decision-making power.
Le « drag-along » (droit d'entraînement): The drag-along: if a buyer wants to acquire 100% of the company, the investor can force the founders to sell too. It stops a minority shareholder from blocking a good sale.
Le « droit de préemption » : si un assoc: The pre-emption right: if a shareholder wants to sell their shares, the other shareholders can buy them first, ahead of any outside buyer. It stops a stranger turning up on the cap table.
Le « droit de première offre » (ROFO) :: The right of first offer (ROFO): before selling shares to a third party, a shareholder must first offer them to the investor. Only if that is refused can they look for an outside buyer.
Le « pay-to-play » : si l'investisseur n: Pay-to-play: if the investor does not put in more money at later rounds, they lose part of their preferential rights (preference, protections). The idea: keeping your advantages means continuing to back the company.
Le « tag-along total » : si l'investisse: The full tag-along: if the investor sells all their shares, the founders have the right to sell theirs at the same time and at the same price. No one is left alone with an imposed new shareholder.
Le cédant propose d'abord ses titres aux: The seller offers their shares to the Investors first
Le censeur est écarté des points où l'In: The observer is excluded from items where the Investor has a conflict
Le cœur de l'accord : combien l'investis: The heart of the deal: how much the investor puts in, and what percentage of the company they get. Here €1M for ≈ 14%. We talk about the pre-money valuation (the value before the investment, €6M) and the post-money valuation (after, €7M).
Le Comité se réunit au moins une fois pa: The Committee meets at least once a quarter
Le comité stratégique (ou « board ») : l: The strategic committee (or board): the forum where founders and investor meet to follow the business and decide the big questions. The contract sets who sits on it and how decisions are taken.
Le délai est prorogé automatiquement si: The deadline is automatically extended if the audit is still under way
Le dividende non versé se cumule et rest: An unpaid dividend accumulates and remains due
Le dividende prioritaire cumulatif : ava: The cumulative preferred dividend: before any distribution to the other shareholders, the investor receives a fixed dividend each year. If it is not paid, it accumulates and remains due. It is a guaranteed return on their investment.
Le document n'a pas changé depuis la der: The document has not changed since the last saved version: no new version created.
Le drag ne joue pas si le prix est infér: The drag-along does not apply if the price is below a floor
Le droit à l'information renforcé : l'in: Enhanced information rights: the investor regularly receives reports (financial results, cash, progress). Having put money in, they have a right to follow how the company is doing.

Le seuil de 30.000 € est bas et peut fre: The €30,000 threshold is low and can slow down day-to-day management. Negotiate higher thresholds and take purely operational decisions off the list.
Les « conditions suspensives » : une lis: Conditions precedent: a list of steps to be cleared before the deal becomes final (satisfactory audit, approvals, signed documents…). Until every condition is satisfied, the deal does not go ahead.
Les « déclarations et garanties » : les: Representations and warranties: the founders formally state that the company's position matches what was presented (accounts, contracts, disputes…). If a statement turns out to be false, they must compensate the investor.
Les « matières réservées » : une liste d: Reserved matters: a list of important decisions (senior hires, borrowing, spending above a threshold…) that the founders cannot take alone — the investor's approval is required first.
Les Actions A priment toute catégorie cr: The A Shares rank ahead of any class created later
Les Actions A se convertissent en ordina: The A Shares convert into ordinary shares on an IPO
Les actions de l'investisseur accumulent: The investor's shares accrue an 8%/year dividend, even if unpaid: it builds up like a debt to be repaid in priority on an exit.
Les annexes font partie intégrante du co: The schedules form an integral part of the contract (cap table, accounts, representations…).

Les clauses de « leaver » : si un fondat: Leaver clauses: if a founder leaves, they may be required to sell back all or part of their shares. The price depends on the circumstances — leaving well ("good leaver") is worth far more than leaving badly ("bad leaver").
Les conditions posées dans leur intérêt: Conditions set for their benefit can be waived by them
Les droits intuitu personae du nouvel en: The newcomer's personal (intuitu personae) rights are excluded
Les enregistrements (dont l'enregistreme: Saving (including autosave) does not create a version: only this button freezes a version, stored separately from your documents.
Les Fondateurs doivent consacrer tout le: The Founders must devote all their working time to the company. A side activity of ≤ 10 hours a month is still tolerated.
Les fondateurs gagnent leurs actions pet: The founders earn their shares gradually over 3 years. Nothing in the first year (the cliff), then a little each month after that. Leaving early = keeping fewer shares.
Les Fondateurs garantissent l'exactitude: The Founders warrant that the company's position is accurate. If a hidden liability appears after closing, they compensate — within limits (cap, duration).
Les fondateurs garantissent que tout ce: The founders guarantee that everything they said about the company is true. If there is a hidden problem, they must pay up to one million euros for 18 months.
Les fondateurs ne peuvent pas vendre leu: The founders cannot sell their shares for 3 years. It shows they believe in their own company. Except to give shares to close family.
Les Fondateurs s'engagent à céder à la s: The Founders undertake to assign to the company all the intellectual property they develop.
Les Fondateurs s'engagent à consacrer 10: The Founders undertake to devote 100% of their time to the Company
Les Fondateurs s'engagent à ne pas vendr: The Founders undertake not to sell their shares for 4 years, except: on a drag-along, on exercise of the leaver options, and a "breathing room" allowing them to sell up to 10% of their shares.
Les Fondateurs sont en fonction et non d: The Founders are in office and have not resigned
Les fondateurs travaillent 5 jours par s: The founders work 5 days a week for the company. No secret second job. The company must be their number one priority.
Les Investisseurs peuvent mandater un ca: The Investors can appoint an audit firm once per financial year
Les Investisseurs peuvent se retirer en: The Investors can walk away on a MAC before Closing
Les Investisseurs reçoivent des « Action: The Investors receive "A Shares". They are described as ordinary: the class mainly serves to identify them so the shareholders' agreement rights can be applied to them.

Si un futur investisseur obtient de meil: If a future investor gets better terms, the current investors automatically benefit from them.
